text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit southbound left-turn movements between 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Monday to Friday, at the Dublin Heights Elementary and Middle School (west) pick-up and drop-off loop located at the private driveway of 100 Bainbridge Avenue, approximately 100 metres east of Dehaviland Street. The prohibition is intended to provide for a more orderly flow off traffic exiting the private driveway onto Bainbridge Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited southbound left-turn movements to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, at Bainbridge Avenue and the westerly private driveway at 100 Bainbridge Avenue, located on the north side of Bainbridge Avenue, approximately 100 metres east of Dehaviland Street.
